rug-checker 0.0.1

- Initial release with Solana token rug-pull risk analysis using a 10-point on-chain check.
- Zero API keys required; operates in read-only mode.
- Generates a visual risk report with detailed scoring and commentary.
- Handles ambiguous token names by prompting user confirmation before checking.
- Includes robust error handling and safety disclaimers.
